data.body: **P2 — Update the core compatibility guidance for 2.3.0.** This release bump leaves `otel-plugin/README.md` identifying the compatible core as `2.2.2-SNAPSHOT`, while `OtelPluginSupport.requireSameThreadInvocationHooks()` and core Javadocs still name 2.2.2. Users upgrading the plugin layer independently of an older application SDK encounter a constructor rejection followed by stale upgrade guidance. Update these references to 2.3.0, or consistently use capability-based wording directing users to the core shipped with this plugin release.
